methods.description: The illustration drawn, or `undefined` when the name is unknown to this set.
methods.name: illustration

options.description: Palette of the brand tones (the accent and neutral tones stay).
options.name: color

options.description: Width: a number in px, or a CSS length. The height follows the 4:3 picture. Default 480px, never wider than the container.
options.name: size

parts.description: Marks a shape drawn as an outline.
parts.name: data-ok-stroke

parts.description: The color tone of a shape, such as `primary` or `neutral`.
parts.name: data-ok-tone

react.description: Renders an illustration's node tree as inline SVG; tones follow the theme through the stylesheet. Decorative unless named (`title`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).

props.description: The picture: an export of `@owlky/core/illustrations` (such as `error404`) or your own data.
props.name: illustration

props.description: Width: a number in px, or a CSS length such as `"20rem"`. Default 480px, never wider than the container.
props.name: size

props.description: The accessible name. With it (or `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`) the picture is an image (`role="img"`); without, it is decorative (`aria-hidden`).
props.name: title
